Perfect! The build now passes. The issue was that `report.py` was calling `shipping.ship_cost_for(product)` but the function was only defined as `ship_cost()` in the shipping module. 

I fixed it by adding `ship_cost_for` as an alias to `ship_cost` at the end of `shopcart/shipping.py`. This allows both function names to work, maintaining compatibility with the existing code that uses `ship_cost()` while satisfying the report module's call to `ship_cost_for()`.
